coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: PKN Frontage Open Space (20th Street)
record.summary: The roughly half-acre '20th Street Plaza' of the D4D open-space network (Section 3.10), the landscaped entry plaza on Parcel K North's 20th Street frontage at Illinois Street, designed as the gateway from Dogpatch to the Historic Core with an entry plaza, seating terrace and planted garden. The Port's Item 9B staff report (2017) lists constructing the 20th/Illinois St. Plaza among the Parcel K North buyer's obligations, and the Port's Parcel K North page says the project will include a 20th St/Illinois St Plaza; no source found reports it built (the Port's Parcel K North page schedule stops at 2020-2021 design and permitting).

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL lot geometry -- the outline is Assessor lot 4110009 (1,365 m2, active), so its edges are recorded lot lines, not a surveyed building footprint: it includes any yard, setback or plaza inside the lot and can sit a little off the walls. Until 2026-10-13 this record showed a bounding-box trace of the Pier 70 Design for Development's Figure 3.3.1 (an illustrative, non-dimensioned plan) trimmed to the real 20th Street centerline; 72% of that outline lies inside the lot and it covered 57% of the lot. No document read names lot 4110009 as the plaza (the Port's plaza parcel is described in Port Resolution 17-52 as a parcel still to be subdivided); the lot is used because it holds most of the earlier drawing (72%), at the owner's direction, and the Design for Development's own name for the space is '20th Street Plaza' (Section 3.10, about 0.5 acre), so the lot's edges are not the plaza's designed edges. The lot is zoned Pier 70 Mixed Use (P70-MU) and was mapped 2019-03-14.
notes.digitized_from: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lot 4110009 (mapped 2019-03-14; active); the earlier outline came from: Pier 70 Design for Development, Figure 3.3.1 - Illustrative Open Space Plan (p.51).
notes.why_no_real_parcel: This record now uses Assessor lot 4110009; see the accuracy note for why that lot is used.
notes.regulatory_context: Part of the Pier 70 D4D's Open Space Network: Section 3.10 '20th Street Plaza', approximately 0.5 acre, an entry plaza with a seating terrace and planted garden along Parcel K North's 20th Street frontage (Figures 3.10.1-3.10.5), shown on Figure 3.3.1 as landscaped open space. Port Item 9B (2017) lists the 20th Street Plaza among the infrastructure obligations retained for the adjacent Illinois Street Parcels.

open_questions: The D4D name '20th Street Plaza' is recorded in this record's map notes, but the record's title is still the placeholder 'PKN Frontage Open Space (20th Street)', which also serves as its identifier and page address; a rename has not yet been decided.

Whether the 'Plaza Parcel' created in 2017 was conveyed with Parcel K North or retained by the Port, and who will build the plaza if the PKN building stays unbuilt, is not stated in the retrieved documents.

No basis for an expected-completion date was found: this plaza is delivered by the Parcel K North buyer, whose own building has no target date (see the Parcel K North record's open questions), and no separate schedule for the plaza itself was found, so this record stays undated.

Maintenance funding for the 20th Street plaza: CFD special taxes from Parcel K North and the Hoedown Yard were projected in 2017 to fund maintenance of Irish Hill Park, Michigan Street, Crane Cove Park and other areas north of 20th Street; Port Item 9B does not name the 20th Street Plaza among them.
